64: That the one who renders her forbidden also renders her permitted - her husband is the one who renders her forbidden -- therefore he can permit her, on the occasion of his death. But the yevama, who is forbidden [to others] by the betrothal of her [original] husband -- how can the death of the yavam permit her?
This as well - when the yavam dies, it turns out that the one who forbids her permits her, for if it were not for [the existence of] the yavam, she would have become permitted once the husband died.
